_comment: Executable claims for OPEN-DECISIONS.md, one JSON object per line. `status` is the state of THIS CLAIM, not of the whole OD entry — an entry can be partly resolved (OD-56's Python half is fixed while its Node transitives are not, so its aiohttp/cryptography claim is `resolved` while OD-56 itself stays open). resolved = the claim MUST hold; if it stops holding, the fix regressed. open = the claim must NOT hold yet; if it starts holding, strike that part of the entry off. See scripts/check_decision_claims.sh and CLAUDE.md §5b.

claim: analytics.controller.ts is guarded (no longer an unauthenticated paid-LLM surface)
jwt-secret.ts throws rather than falling back to a published string
SimposController is guarded AND SimposModule stays gated out of production
no bare fetch() of a user-supplied URL remains in vendor-page-extractor — both sites go through safeFetch
splitPdfIfLarge caps pages, so chunk count cannot track an uploaded PDF's page count
the four pos_* tables carry foreign keys (was 3, now 13)
aiohttp and cryptography are pinned at or above their patched versions (the Python half of OD-56; the Node transitives are separate and still open)
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; s=open('services/agent-orchestrator/requirements.txt').read(); a=re.search(r'^aiohttp==(\\S+)',s,re.M).group(1); c=re.search(r'^cryptography==(\\S+)',s,re.M).group(1); v=lambda x:[int(n) for n in x.split('.')]; sys.exit(0 if v(a)>=[3,14,3] and v(c)>=[50,0,0] else 1)"

claim: calendar_agent's regex fallback is NOT fed the prompt template (fixed in #57; the separate question of provider_important_dates not existing in production is OD-68)
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; s=open('services/agent-orchestrator/agents/calendar_agent.py').read(); sys.exit(1 if re.search(r'_regex_date_extraction\\(\\s*prompt\\s*\\)', s) else 0)"

claim: no file in apps/web/src imports the browser anon-key Supabase client any more (OD-45 removed useReportQueries; useSommelierQueries is the last one). Holds when the sommelier surface is routed through the gateway, or when the hook is deleted
a migration revokes anon's DML on the procurement document tables, so the invoice store is not readable/writable with the public anon key
verify: python3 -c "import glob,re,sys; pat=re.compile(r'revoke\s+all[^;]*\bprocurement_documents\b[^;]*\bfrom\b[^;]*\banon\b',re.I|re.S); sys.exit(0 if [f for f in glob.glob('supabase/migrations/*.sql') if pat.search(open(f,errors='ignore').read())] else 1)"

claim: document_extraction grades itself: the reconciliation verdict is wired from applyTieOut into nf_verdict, invoices only
nf_verdict ships with RLS enabled and anon/authenticated revoked in its CREATING migration, not a follow-up
verify: grep -q 'alter table public.nf_verdict enable row level security' supabase/migrations/20260825180000_nf_verdict.sql && grep -q 'revoke all on public.nf_verdict from anon, authenticated' supabase/migrations/20260825180000_nf_verdict.sql

claim: the verified-cost readout GROUPS by basis rather than filtering, so two graders can never average into one figure
the tie-out tolerance has one definition, shared by the grader and the evidence it records
the Python emitter returns the inserted NF row id, so a verdict can attach to it
rfq_agent stamps a parse-level basis rather than asserting success above the parse
the spine names exactly one current milestone — P2 — in all three docs
verify: grep -q 'Current milestone: P2' .planning/STATE.md && grep -q 'Current Milestone: P2' .planning/PROJECT.md && grep -q '## Now — P2' .planning/ROADMAP.md

claim: every page note in 06-pages carries a Surface section (the page graph is complete)
no web source navigates to the dead routes /documents or /emails
verify: test "$(grep -rn "'/documents'\|\"/documents\"\|'/emails'\|\"/emails\"" apps/web/src --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts' | grep -v documents-reports | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 0

claim: TenantGuard denies a tenantless session that names a restaurant
the communications test/e2e routes are unreachable in production
apps/web/src/types/companyClass.ts is deleted and types/index.ts no longer re-exports it
verify: test -f apps/web/src/types/index.ts && test ! -f apps/web/src/types/companyClass.ts && ! grep -q companyClass apps/web/src/types/index.ts

claim: the three dead exports are gone from apps/web/src/data/customEventTypes.ts while the module and isEventTypeNameAvailable survive
verify: test -f apps/web/src/data/customEventTypes.ts && grep -q 'export function isEventTypeNameAvailable' apps/web/src/data/customEventTypes.ts && ! grep -qE 'export (function isCustomEventType|function getCustomEventTypeByName|const EVENT_TYPE_COLORS)' apps/web/src/data/customEventTypes.ts
